races.paceDynamic: Approval will take them along as the sole confirmed front runner, likely setting a steady tempo without early pressure from the large field. The prominent racers Pure Logic, Jerry From Kerry, Minella Mate and Individualism will track behind, while the majority including Magico, Tyson Fury, Bud Fox and Ancient Myth will sit further back employing hold-up tactics. With such a weight of numbers held up and Approval potentially getting an easy lead, this sets up perfectly for the patient hold-up horses to deliver late. The tactical verdict clearly favours hold-up horses who can benefit from the likely steady pace and finish strongly.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Brigade Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Approval gets an uncontested lead and the pace stays moderate through the early stages.
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up horses get the perfect setup to unleash finishing kicks, with Magico and Tyson Fury ideally positioned to pounce. The weight of hold-up talent in this field makes them very hard to oppose with the right race shape.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressers Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If Pure Logic or Jerry From Kerry press Approval early and create a stronger gallop than expected.
scenarios.body: The increased pace stretches the field and favours those tracking in behind the leaders who avoid the early burn-up. Pure Logic's consistency and Jerry From Kerry's recent form make them live dangers if positioned right.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Approval Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Approval's uncontested lead proves too valuable and he finds enough stamina to repel late challengers.
scenarios.body: The front runner maximises his tactical advantage by getting first run on the field and holding on grimly. His proven ability on good going and the lack of early pace pressure could see him steal this.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the market leaders fail to fire and one of the outsiders produces a career-best effort.
scenarios.body: The race falls apart tactically or the favourites disappoint, allowing a lesser-fancied runner to capitalise on the chaos. Whet The Appetite's recent run or Goodmancon's consistency could see them sneak into contention.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Approval gets an easy uncontested lead as the sole front runner - could steal a march on this talented but rusty field.
Monitor Pure Logic and Jerry From Kerry for early pressure on Approval as this could change the entire complexion of the race.
Keep an eye on Magico's market moves given Paul Townend's presence and the Mullins stable's excellent record with hold-up horses.
Watch the pace through the early stages as a steady gallop strongly favours the numerous hold-up horses in this field.
Monitor any late market support for the long-absent runners like Minella Mate and Ancient Myth as stable confidence could be telling.

races.paceDynamic: Break My Soul emerges as the sole confirmed front-runner in this Listed mares' contest, setting up to dictate terms from the outset with Keith Donoghue able to control the tempo. With six prominent runners including Dunsy Rock, Disco Dancer, Sainte Lucie, Tir Og, and Queenofthelodge all likely to race handily, there's sufficient pace behind the leader to ensure steady galloping rather than crawling fractions. The four hold-up runners (Royal Hollow, Redwood Queen, Bynx, Katherine) will need the prominently-raced horses to maintain honest tempo to have any chance. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the pace and strike turning for home, as they'll get the ideal trip behind Break My Soul's controlled lead.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Break My Soul sets steady fractions and the prominent brigade get the perfect stalking trip
scenarios.body: The prominently-raced horses will be perfectly positioned to challenge turning for home as Break My Soul comes back to them. Sainte Lucie and Dunsy Rock have the class to capitalize on this tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Break My Soul faces no serious early pressure and can dictate conservative fractions throughout
scenarios.body: With her superior class (OR 137) and tactical advantage, Break My Soul can kick clear when ready and prove difficult to peg back. The hold-up horses will have too much ground to make up.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Challenge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely strong with prominent runners pressing Break My Soul harder than expected
scenarios.body: Royal Hollow and Redwood Queen could benefit from a stronger gallop that sets up their closing kicks. However, they'll need significant pace collapse to be effective.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If Break My Soul goes too slowly early and the race becomes a tactical crawl with no pressure applied
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the last hurdle where any runner could prevail in a bunched finish. This scenario requires Break My Soul to misjudge pace badly.

watchPoints.text: Break My Soul must be monitored early - if she faces unexpected pressure from prominent runners, her tactical advantage disappears completely.
Watch Sainte Lucie's position tracking the leader - if Townend gets the perfect stalking trip, her class could prove decisive.
Royal Hollow needs genuine pace pressure early or her hold-up style becomes ineffective in this race shape.
Observe how many of the six prominent runners actually go forward - if several drop back, it changes the pace dynamic significantly.
Monitor the pace through the first mile - if it's genuinely steady, the hold-up horses have no realistic chance.

This setup clearly favours horses with tactical speed who can position handy and quicken - the prominent group holds all the aces over pure hold-up horses like Ragmans Corner.

races.paceDynamic: Butch Cassidy will be the undisputed pace-setter from the start, with his prominent style likely taking the field along at a manageable tempo in this small six-runner field. With no other natural front-runners and mostly hold-up horses behind him, Butch Cassidy should get an easy lead and dictate terms throughout. The lack of pace pressure means the tempo will build gradually, setting up a tactical finish where the early leader gets first run but the hold-up horses get their chance to close. This race shape clearly favours horses with tactical speed who can sit close enough to strike - prominent runners and strong travellers will have the edge over pure hold-up horses who may find too much to do.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Butch Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Butch Cassidy maintains his jumping rhythm and gets soft fractions on the front end.
scenarios.body: His prominent style perfectly suits controlling this pace-light field, and the Henry De Bromhead stable is in good form with Brian Hayes riding confidently. The lack of early pressure allows him to conserve energy for a sustained finish from the front.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Swamp Leader
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and the hold-up brigade get perfect racing room in the straight.
scenarios.body: Sandor Clegane and Da Capo Glory both have superior class ratings and will be finishing strongly if they get the right splits. Their hold-up styles benefit most when they can unleash one decisive move in the final half-mile.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: D Art D Art Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the 125-rated former hurdler produces his best form and gets a good run through.
scenarios.body: His recent Cheltenham Pertemps Final experience shows he has class, and being fresh off just a 2-day break suggests connections are confident. His hold-up style could benefit from a slowly-run race if he rediscovers his early season sparkle.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If Butch Cassidy ties up badly in the straight and multiple hold-up horses charge past.
scenarios.body: The outsiders Justabitofyours and The Rebel County could benefit most from a completely collapsed pace scenario. Both are hold-up horses who need everything to fall right, but stranger things have happened in small novice chase fields.

watchPoints.text: Butch Cassidy's jumping under pressure - if he makes any significant errors when challenged, his front-running advantage evaporates quickly
Paul Nolan's terrible recent form (0/14) could impact Sandor Clegane's chances despite his superior class rating
Da Capo Glory's headgear change from just a noseband to wearing cheekpieces suggests trainer is trying to sharpen his focus
The pace early on - if Butch Cassidy goes too fast trying to steal the race, it sets up the hold-up horses perfectly
D Art D Art's quick 2-day turnaround either indicates supreme confidence from connections or desperation to get a win

races.paceDynamic: Miss Doyenne, Emily Love, La Note Verte and Affinity Rock will ensure a strong early gallop in this mares' beginners chase over 2m5f at Killarney. The quartet of confirmed front-runners creates a pace scenario that will test stamina reserves, particularly given the extended distance and the likelihood of tactical positioning battles early. With such sustained pressure from the flag, horses that can settle and produce late rallies will have a significant tactical advantage. This race shape strongly favours hold-up performers who can capitalize on the inevitable pace collapse in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the four pace-setters maintain their aggressive tempo through the middle stages
scenarios.body: The relentless gallop will drain the leaders' reserves, creating perfect conditions for a closer to sweep past tired rivals in the final furlong. Horses like Gaoth Chuil and Billie Frechette are ideally positioned to exploit this pace collapse.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Survives Duel
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters can break clear of the early battle and dictate alone
scenarios.body: Emily Love or Miss Doyenne could establish a crucial advantage by avoiding the early scrap, maintaining enough energy to resist late challengers. Their class and proven stamina make them capable of lasting home.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly unsustainable and multiple leaders weaken simultaneously
scenarios.body: Stormalong can position perfectly behind the early battle, tracking the pace without engaging, then strike when the leaders falter. This scenario rewards tactical patience and finishing speed over pure stamina.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If the early gallop is so fierce that even the hold-up horses struggle to make ground
scenarios.body: A complete pace meltdown could favor any horse that avoided the early carnage entirely, regardless of typical running style. Long-absent runners with fresh legs might capitalize on the chaos.

watchPoints.text: Crescent Moon has pulled up in three consecutive starts and may not complete the course despite hold-up style suiting the pace.
Emily Love and La Note Verte face fitness questions after 200+ day absences despite their class advantage from top yards.
My Mary Ellen's unknown running style could disrupt pace calculations if she joins the early battle unexpectedly.
Stormalong's 65-day break may compromise his ability to capitalize on the expected pace scenario despite suitable style.
The four confirmed pace-setters could engage too early and allow a surprise winner from the back-markers to emerge.

The lack of early pace pressure strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce late bursts over the final half-mile.

scenarios.body: The early leaders prove their class by sustaining their gallop right to the line, with hold-up horses unable to make up sufficient ground despite their fresh finish. Front-running tactics vindicated.
